layman_headline: The crypto market is fearful and most altcoins look weak — patience is the best trade right now.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market mood sits at 27 out of 100 — solidly in 'Fear' territory and trending worse. Bitcoin is down about 1.6% over the past week while most altcoins are bleeding harder, with many down 7-10%. The few coins showing strength (like KAITO up 17% in a week) are dangerously overbought, and the ones that have pulled back enough to look cheap are still in clear downtrends with no signs of bottoming yet. There's no compelling catalyst in the news to spark a reversal right now.
layman_action: Stay on the sidelines and keep your cash ready. Wait for either a deeper fear reading (below 20) with signs of a bounce, or for one of these oversold coins to form a clear bottom pattern before committing money.
expert_reasoning: I evaluated all seven swing candidates systematically. KAITO has strong momentum (+87% 5-day, Three White Soldiers) but RSI at 87 is extremely overbought — per my signal credibility data, RSI is my most reliable indicator (71% win rate), and an RSI of 87 screams 'do not buy.' TRUMP and BONK have oversold RSIs (27 and 29 respectively), which normally attract me, but both are in confirmed downtrends below all moving averages with bearish chart patterns — catching a falling knife in a Fear environment with 56.3% BTC dominance crushing alts is not a high-probability swing trade. ENA has a strongly bearish chart (-1.70 bias) with an Evening Star reversal pattern. LDO shows a mild pullback with neutral RSI but no clear entry signal. PEPE is approaching oversold but shows indecision (Doji) in a downtrend. The Fear & Greed at 27 with a worsening trend, combined with high BTC dominance, makes alt exposure particularly risky. Per my validated rules, Fear at 27 is close to the 25 threshold where the outlook becomes genuinely ambiguous — holding is the safest call.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed trending worse could push to extreme fear territory, causing another leg down across all crypto assets
BTC dominance at 56.3% and rising means capital is rotating out of alts — any alt position faces dual risk of BTC dropping AND losing relative ground
The $70-89M cold wallet attack and $265M ETF outflows suggest institutional caution that could persist for days
watch_list: Fear & Greed Index — watch for either a drop below 20 (potential capitulation/bounce setup) or a recovery above 35 (improving sentiment for entries)
TRUMP and BONK RSI readings — if they drop below 25 while forming a bullish reversal candle pattern like a hammer or morning star, that would be a much stronger buy signal
Bitcoin ETF flow data over the next 48 hours — continued outflows would confirm bearish momentum, while inflows would signal a sentiment shift
market_context: Crypto markets are in a Fear state (27/100) with worsening sentiment, BTC down 1.6% weekly, and altcoins bleeding 7-10%. High BTC dominance at 56.3% signals ongoing rotation away from alts, making this a poor environment for new altcoin swing entries.
context_banner: Market fear is elevated and worsening with no clear reversal catalyst — capital preservation takes priority over chasing setups in weak conditions.

key_signals.description: KAITO RSI at 87 is extremely overbought, ruling out the strongest momentum candidate; TRUMP (27) and BONK (29) are oversold but lack confirming reversal patterns.
Fear & Greed at 27 with a worsening weekly trend suggests the market hasn't found a bottom yet — close to the 25 threshold where my validated rules recommend holding.
Bitcoin ETFs bled $265M in 24 hours, signaling institutional risk-off behavior that typically precedes further weakness in altcoins.
A cold wallet attack spreading to 4,500 addresses with $89M in losses adds security-related FUD that could suppress risk appetite across the market.
No volume breakout signals detected on any candidate — ADA's 8.4% daily gain and 11.8% weekly gain in the top-20 is notable but wasn't on the swing candidate list for detailed analysis.
